html.body: Date: 2025-03-06 REMARKSIn response to the Office Action dated January 30, 2025, Applicant amends claim 6. No new matter is added. After entry of this Amendment, claims 1-6 are pending in the Application.Reconsideration of the Application as amended is respectfully requested in view of these remarks.Allowable Subject Matter Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that claims 1-5 are allowed.Rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) Claim 6 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) as allegedly being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter that Applicant or the inventor regards as the invention.Claim 6 is amended to overcome the rejection. Applicant submits that the claim is now in allowable form.Applicant accordingly requests that the rejection of claim 6 under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) be reconsidered and withdrawn.Conclusion It is submitted that this Amendment has antecedent basis in the application as originally filed, including the specification, claims and drawings, and that this Amendment does not add any new subject matter to the application. It is submitted that this Amendment places the application in suitable condition for allowance, notice of which is requested.The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the telephone number listed below if the Examiner believes an Examiner's amendment would expedite prosecution of the Application.Respectfully submitted, YOUNG BASILEHANLON & MACFARLANE, P.C./Francine Nesti / Francine Nesti Registration No. 53,376 T: (248) 649-3333 F: (248) 649-3338 3001 West Big Beaver Road, Ste. 624 Troy, Michigan 48084-3107
